subject.title: Crestodian talk-to-agent command can miss the app handoff

question: Should exact documented Crestodian agent-handoff selectors such as `talk to agent` bypass the usable-model turn and return the host `open-agent` action deterministically?
rationale: The source-reproducible failure is clear, but the fix changes the host-vs-AI boundary for a documented natural-language command in a first-run onboarding flow.

options.title: Land deterministic exact handoff
options.body: Treat exact documented handoff selectors as host navigation before the model path while leaving broader Crestodian chat AI-owned.

options.title: Keep model-owned handoff
options.body: Leave `talk to agent` dependent on the model/tool directive and accept that the app can remain in Crestodian after a text-only handoff reply.

options.title: Broaden boundary review
options.body: Pause the narrow fix and audit all Crestodian host-navigation commands before changing this boundary.

recommendation.title: Land deterministic exact handoff
recommendation.body: Treat exact documented handoff selectors as host navigation before the model path while leaving broader Crestodian chat AI-owned.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the current code path by blame and owns the open linked candidate fix.
